# roadie_secret (Resource)

Manages a Roadie secret. Creates the secret metadata and sets its value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "roadie_secret" "pagerduty_token" {
  ref         = "PAGERDUTY_TOKEN"
  name        = "PagerDuty Token"
  description = "API token for PagerDuty integration"
  value       = var.pagerduty_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-friendly display name for the secret.
- `ref` (String) The secret reference key used in ${...} placeholders (e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value. Write-only — never returned by the API.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of what this secret is used for.
- `help_url` (String) URL linking to documentation about obtaining this secret.

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) Current status of the secret: Available or Not Set.
